thread.title_full: Trump to Launch Investigation Into California's "$130 Billion" High-Speed Rail Disaster Project | The Gateway Pundit | by Jim Hᴏft

author: Suchen
text: I currently live in southern NJ and the Democrats converted a freight train and tracks into a commuter rail that runs from Trenton, NJ to Camden, NJ. they projected the initial cost to do this at 450 million. Everyone I knew was against it. It devalued hundreds of homes in 15 small, sleepy riverfront towns and the train (by Democrat law) must blast its horns at every crossing even though there are lights and automatic gates. The thing is an atrocious 2 car, diesel belching, behemoth that mostly carries drug dealers and thieves. Its nick name is the "Robb n Ride" due to the fact that the thieves get off at various stops, steal from local stores and homes, get back on and disappear. The final cost ended up being over 2 billion and its annual operating budget takes $70,000,000 (million) just to break even. The ticket costs $1.10 IF they pay but its rarely enforced. This disgusting train brings in only $3.5 million a year and loses 66.5 million a year. All because Democrats wanted their pet project so they could skim and take some cash for themselves. There are still buses that run the same route and most people in these area's drive to work. I am happy to hear that this California project is under investigation because there is no doubt in my mind that California taxpayers are being ripped off into the billions.
